name: Site Onboarding and Local Authorization
purpose: Control admission of a proposed physical site into the multisite program through identity, authorization, geospatial verification, operator readiness and local regulatory/QMS pathway checks.
decision_rules: administrative/reporting nodes may be onboarded without being classified as physical sites
physical site identity must be geospatially verified before collection
operator and collector accountability must be explicit
local regulatory and product-release scope must be identified before release planning
QMS pathway must be identified where water/product testing applies
DMRV and anchor identities must be unique to the site
fail_closed_conditions: collector readiness missing for planned collection
permissible_claims: site proposal is under onboarding review
a defined site has been admitted to the controlled program
a reporting node exists without implying physical installation
prohibited_claims: site admission proves a harvest occurred
